pages.text: A Containment Field is a crafting component. Containment Fields are generally used in devices that need to keep something confined within an area.$(br2)Containment Fields can be used to upgrade $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/radianttank)Radiant Tanks$(/l).$(br2)Containment Fields can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
